title: Research: exclude P112 2,3,4,6^8 with a common-cut span bound
body:
## Summary

```diff
 two P112 six-flat covers + ONE common fourteen-line cut
- rank-six span bound left open by PR3185
+ every admissible direction family spans at most five
+ exclude TWOSIDE (6,5) profile 2,3,4,6^8
```

Only `research/p112-common-fourteen-cut/` is added. The theorem covers every characteristic-zero field through the stated Weyl-chamber argument and exact finite census. It does not establish full C5, `C(P112)>=64`, supplier admission or a new κ.

The package includes the written proof, exact checker, complete receipt, source pins and reproduction instructions. A separate least-coset enumerator checks the RREF flat inventory. The replay also rechecks PR3185's root-cover premise needed for the quotient basis. The original TWOSIDE reduction remains inherited.

Credit DreamingOfClouds/PR3154, Nick Petalas/PR3185 and PR3161/3162/3163, and the retained E8/P112 decoder lineage. [Canonical investigation](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/3156#discussioncomment-19000629).

## Evidence

- Before: PR3185 supplied the five-piece quotient basis but needed this exact common-set span bound. After: all 160 first-mask orbits, including the empty mask, pass. The symmetry-reduced replay checks 6,479,662 mask-pair cases, 13,610,242 deletion oracles and 537,181 common-cut states across 4,938 relevant pairs.
- All 788,035 annihilators and 776,806 masks agree under two enumerations. The complete direction inventory has 1,144 normals; direct short-lattice generation agrees. Ninety-six native/Fraction rank controls agree.
- Fourteen behavioral groups pass, including three compiled rejecting mutants, source/receipt/partial-output controls and clean rejection of extreme CLI ranges. Strict native diagnostics and Ruff pass.
- Registered Python 3.12 replay, read-only Git-free Python 3.13 committed export and publication-byte checks pass at `a8eec63ecb495b2969d4962b4d4d1a35706b8cb2`. Hosted CI is separate. These are author checks, not independent human or proof-kernel review.

```sh
python3.12 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/p112-common-fourteen-cut
# See the README for external-output standalone commands.
```

Canonical main remained `997e6a9ca7b4f95d50e366f61412fd640d72a88a`, priority revision 6, at the 16:22 UTC submission refresh. Live overlap covered 310 open PRs and 1,976 Discussions with complete pagination and no warnings; adjacent PR3188 explicitly separates this question.

Open next question: bind this proved theorem to another actual remaining profile before expanding the census. Development and local checking used substantial automated assistance.

## Merge Danger

**Door:** two-way

**Blast Radius:** research

Additive package only. No selected-frontier, shared-tool or frozen-source changes. Archival integration would not itself constitute scientific approval.
